I don't understand the issues with Patient Access, the online portal that is supposed to eradicate the very dated paper prescription drop-offs at the practice to get your medication.

The practice continually tell me there are 'national issues' with Patient Access and that they don't always receive the medication requests coming through and you need to ring them up to tell them you've put a script through!  I do this. The script still isn't issued! They then tell you the dispensary team will call, and you're on the list, but no call ever arrives! I recently had a text saying 3 meds were ready going back to 1st August, yet they were not even there when I went to pick up!!

I've been with this practice for a few months now. I never ever had a problem with my previous practice (in terms of Patient Access) and used Patient Access with them for years with no issues but I'm now finding it so frustrating because it's now causing delays and items I've not even asked for to be prescribed. I've Googled national problems with Patient Access but can not find any issues reported!

May 24.   MY FIRST REVIEW.  I must say I'm 💯 impressed with this medical practice so far! BELIEVE ME compared to the TELDOC practices in Telford, the service is impeccable. No waiting for hours on the phone, really friendly and helpful receptionists/dispensary staff, appointments pretty much straight away. My only issue is the patient access portal. There seems to have been an issue for over 12 weeks and nationally in scripts not going through. But.... unlike telford practices, you can order a script over the phone. I'm very
